source.extractionTool: pdftotext (poppler), -enc UTF-8, -layout mode; pdfplumber for raised characters (powers, degree signs) and positions; pdfplumber page renders to check equation-editor content
source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. From the CISCE Archive Library ICSE 2023 question-paper bundle. Paper code "T23 511" printed on every page; 'Maximum Marks: 80', 'Time allowed: Two and half hours'; cover says 11 printed pages and 1 blank page (the PDF has 11 pages). Section A (40 marks, compulsory): Question 1 = 15 MCQs under a single [15] (1 mark each), Questions 2 and 3 split at each (i)/(ii)/(iii) with printed marks. Section B (40 marks): 'Attempt any four questions' from Questions 4-10 (10 marks each); a pick-4-of-7 choice, not an OR pair, so choiceGroup is not used and all seven are included; the pack's marks total (110) therefore exceeds maxMarks (80) by design. (a)/(b)/(c) items inside a sub-part share one printed mark and are kept together. Notation: powers and degree signs are raised characters that pdftotext flattens (x3, 30o); they were checked with pdfplumber (smaller raised glyphs) and rebuilt as x³, 30° (flagged MEDIUM). Equation-editor content (matrices in Q1(i) and Q4(i), the inequation in Q5(ii), the componendo-dividendo equation in Q9(i)) is garbled in the text layer (Cambria Math glyphs doubled or mis-mapped, matrix brackets lost); it was rebuilt from the positions of the digits and checked against a render of the page, and flagged. The rupee sign is a Rupee-font glyph that extracts as '`'; normalised to ₹. Tables are reproduced as text rows. No cognitive-level tags are printed on this paper.
